summary: citecheck builds its source text from the user's own Lexis+ Word download (reporter page markers, majority/concurrence/dissent headings, footnotes) and matches quotations word for word; a regen must not replace this with web scraping or a looser fuzzy match.
reason: A cite check is only as good as the text and page numbers it compares against; the Word copy is the one Lexis output that carries official pagination and speaker labels.
